SwitchPreference.android:title: Use token for kiosk
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch data for the kiosk.\nNot using a token will only show the top 30 streams.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Use token for search
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch search results.\nNot using a token will only show the first ~30 results.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Use token for categories
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch the streams of a category.\nNot using a token will only show the top 100 streams.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Use token for channel clips
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch the clips of a channel.\nNot using a token will only show the top 100 clips.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Use token for channel vods
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch the vods of a channel.\nNot using a token will only show the ~30 latest vods.
